events.title: IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP)
events.description: Statistical learning and signal processing, including generative models, multimodal learning, and biomedical applications. [Venue: Centennial Hall](https://mlsp26.ieeesps.org/getting-to-the-conference/).

events.title: Georgia Statistics Day
events.description: Research talks and student posters connecting the regional statistics community; 8 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Keynote speaker: Jianqing Fan.

events.title: Emory AI for Health Symposium
events.description: The fourth symposium on AI in medicine and health, at 1760 Haygood Drive NE.

events.title: NeurIPS 2026 — Atlanta satellite
events.description: Main-conference sessions and tutorials run December 9–11; workshops follow December 12–13. See the [venue information](https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2026/VenueInformation) and the [official list of 26 Atlanta workshops](https://blog.neurips.cc/2026/08/10/announcing-the-neurips-2026-workshops/). Topics include uncertainty-aware decisions, evaluation of agents, reliable clinical simulation, and biomolecular design. Sydney hosts the main meeting December 6–12, while Atlanta and Paris have their own local programs.

events.title: World Models for High-Stakes Health
events.description: NeurIPS Atlanta workshop. Clinical-trial simulation, treatment-effect estimation, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification using longitudinal patient data; rooms C208–C209.

events.title: Agentic Intelligence for Medical Imaging and Multimodal Clinical Data (AIM-NeurIPS)
events.description: NeurIPS Atlanta workshop. AI agents that combine medical images, clinical records, and analysis tools, with an emphasis on evaluation, reliability, and human oversight.

events.title: Generative and Experimental Perspectives for Biomolecular Design (GEM)
events.description: NeurIPS Atlanta workshop. Generative models, active learning, and experimental validation for proteins, molecules, and nucleic acids; relevant to computational biology and drug discovery.

events.title: Machine Learning & the Physical Sciences
events.description: Hosted by the AI4Science Center, this independent workshop connects machine learning with physical-science research. It is near the NeurIPS venue but is not an official NeurIPS workshop in 2026.

events.title: Suddath Symposium
events.description: Experimental, computational, and AI approaches to predictive biomedical models, drug development, and toxicity assessment. Venue: Petit Biotechnology Building, Suddath Seminar Room 1128.

events.title: APHL ID Lab Con
events.description: An applied public-health laboratory conference with tracks on pathogen genomics, infectious-disease outbreaks, and surveillance. The March 15 Advanced Molecular Detection workshop covers metagenomic sequencing, bioinformatics workflows, and genomic epidemiology.

events.title: SIAM Conference on Applications of Dynamical Systems (DS27)
events.description: Includes data-driven and AI-informed dynamical systems, stochastic dynamics, and scientific applications.

events.title: ACM Federated Computing Research Conference (FCRC)
events.description: Co-located computing conferences connect statistical modeling, learning theory, simulation, and computing systems. See STOC, SIGMETRICS, and SIGSIM-PADS below. [SPAA](https://spaa.acm.org/) and [PLDI](https://conf.researchr.org/home/pldi-2027/) also participate in FCRC week; check their programs for individual dates.

events.title: STOC 2027
events.description: Part of FCRC. Theory of computation, including a day on theoretical computer science and AI.

events.title: SIGMETRICS 2027
events.description: Part of FCRC. Measurement, statistical modeling, and performance analysis of computing systems.

events.title: SIGSIM-PADS 2027
events.description: Part of FCRC. Simulation methods and systems for modeling complex processes.

events.title: UGA Statistics Industry Day
events.description: Statistics and industry connections, featuring Shan Ba; Caldwell Hall, Room 204.

events.title: Georgia State Graduate Conference for Research, Scholarship and Creative Activity
events.description: Graduate research from all disciplines, with presentations and opportunities to connect across departments. Abstract submission for this edition has closed.

events.title: Kennesaw State Fall Analytics Day
events.description: Student analytics projects and conversations with regional industry practitioners; 8:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m.

events.title: Emerging Researchers National Conference in STEM (ERN)
events.description: A broad student research conference. The organizer has announced the 2027 dates; submission requirements for that edition are still being updated.

events.title: ASA DataFest at UGA
events.description: A student data-analysis competition; consult the departmental calendar for participation and venue details.

events.title: Atlanta AI Week
events.description: Sessions and workshops on implementing AI, enterprise applications, and the local startup community.
events.date_note: April 2027; exact dates to be announced

events.title: AI Connect Expo
events.description: An industry exhibition and conference focused on AI applications and technology providers; the organizer's [event information](https://aiconnectexpo.com/sitemap) lists the dates and venue.

events.title: SLDS 2026: Inference and Intelligence
events.location: Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge, New York
events.description: Statistical learning and data science. This meeting is outside the Atlanta region; abstract submission has closed.

events.title: Atlanta Mathematics of Data Science Bootcamp
events.description: Tutorials and projects on the mathematical foundations of data science and ML, for undergraduate and high-school students.

events.title: ACM AI Leadership Summit
events.description: AI research, agentic systems, governance, and applications across academia and industry.

events.title: STI Prevention Conference
events.description: Applied public-health research on sexually transmitted infections, prevention strategies, and service delivery, connecting researchers with clinical and community partners.

events.title: FOPAM 2026
events.location: Courtyard by Marriott Atlanta Decatur Downtown/Emory, Decatur
events.description: Process and product analytics and machine learning. The [July 26–27 pre-conference workshop](https://dais.chbe.ubc.ca/fopam2026/) connected experimental design and regression with deep learning, LLMs, and AI agents.

events.title: Summer Institute in Statistics and Modeling in Infectious Diseases (SISMID)
events.description: In-person short courses in statistical and infectious-disease modeling, including ML, MCMC, and simulation-based inference; online modules ran June 22–26.

events.title: Atlanta Cloud + AI Conference
events.description: Practitioner sessions on cloud infrastructure, AI applications, RAG, and model deployment. See the organizer's [2026 event packet](https://atlcloudconf.com/assets/pdfs/ATLCloud%2BAIConf2026-SponsorshipPacket.pdf).

events.title: STATGEN 2026
events.description: The ASA Section on Statistics in Genomics and Genetics conference, co-organized by Emory's Department of Biostatistics and Bioinformatics, on statistical methodology for genomic and genetic data.

events.title: 11th Workshop on Biostatistics and Bioinformatics
events.description: Organized by Yichuan Zhao, with research talks and student posters. Yong Chen's May 8 short course covered federated learning for collaborative health research using PDA and the MOSAiC framework.

events.title: CDC Epidemic Intelligence Service (EIS) Conference
events.description: Applied epidemiology, disease investigations, and public-health data analysis. The organizer links to the 2026 agenda, presentation abstracts, and recorded sessions.

events.title: Atlanta AI Week 2026
events.description: Enterprise AI, practical workshops, and startup networking.

events.title: Georgia State Undergraduate Research Conference (GSURC)
events.description: Undergraduate research, scholarship, and creative projects across disciplines.

events.title: INFORMS Optimization Society Conference
events.description: Optimization for data science, decisions under uncertainty, and computational methods.

events.title: Computational Cognition Conference (CoCo Con)
events.description: Computational approaches to cognition and their connections with AI.

events.title: Southeast Regional Clinical & Translational Science Conference
events.location: Callaway Resort and Gardens, Pine Mountain, Georgia
events.description: Georgia CTSA's regional meeting connected clinical and translational researchers. The [2026 program](https://georgiactsa.org/_includes/documents/sections/research/cmdts/2026-conf-agenda-final.pdf) included medical AI implementation, clinical prediction, imaging, and LLM applications.

events.title: Georgia CTSA BERD Research Forum
events.description: The Biostatistics, Epidemiology, and Research Design forum focused on artificial intelligence in medical and health care systems, with research presentations and graduate-student posters.

events.title: ASA/IMS Spring Research Conference
events.description: A regional option beyond Georgia for research in statistics and its applications.

events.title: Design and Analysis of Experiments
events.description: Research on experimental design and analysis.
